what_happened: Research cleanly decided grant-narrowing shape (remove all 4 write-tool grants) and surfaced 3 additional in-scope sapience-domain files (review-gate-boundary.md, EXTENSION.md, README.md) stating the stale 11-tool/4-write-tool fact beyond the 2 files the dispatch named explicitly, plus the pre-existing merge-additivity limitation that will leave this repo's own settings.local.json unchanged by a source-only edit.

Plan sizing caught four coupled surfaces the research report's edit set omitted: verify-sapience-mcp.sh hardcodes the grant count as -eq 11 (it is the probe the task's own acceptance criterion relies on, so it would report failure against a correct narrowing), permission-configuration.md names the sapience worked example explicitly (research assessed it as a fact-free pointer), and manifest.json plus index-entries.json both carry the 11-grant figure. Found by grepping the literal value across the whole source store including scripts/ and JSON metadata, not only markdown.
